title: Access Code Intercepted in Transit
description: Temporary access code transmitted from Guest User to Home Hub could be intercepted if communication channel is unencrypted.
assumptions: Assumes code is sent over network without encryption.

title: Access Code Linked to Guest Identity
description: Home Hub may log access codes with guest identifiers, enabling linkage of temporary codes to specific individuals.
assumptions: Assumes Home Hub retains logs associating codes with guest data.

title: Guest Unaware of Data Processing
description: Guest may not be informed that their access code is processed/stored by the Home Hub.
assumptions: Assumes no transparency about data handling practices.

title: Non-Compliant Data Retention
description: Home Hub may retain access codes longer than necessary for security purposes, violating data minimization principles.
assumptions: Assumes no defined retention policy for temporary codes.
